primaryContext.candidateText: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
primaryContext.fixedText: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build the LORD’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

primaryContext.candidateText: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
primaryContext.fixedText: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

primaryContext.candidateText: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
primaryContext.fixedText: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
